info.title: peopleDesk
info.description: SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE, written for workday-integration's checks: the shape of a Workday REST specification (OpenAPI 2.0, $ref, allOf, an ID that accepts me, Secured By Domain and Scope in the descriptions), with made-up resources and fields. It is not one of Workday's APIs.

workerId.name: ID
workerId.description:
The Workday ID of the resource.

Accepts:
- **Workday ID**: Workday ID (32-character lowercase hexadecimal string).
- **Reference ID**: Workday reference ID (Type=Value). Valid types: Employee_ID, Contingent_Worker_ID
- **Named entry**: Valid values: `me`.
